For the Petitioner: Mr. Binod Singh, Advocate  For the O.P-State: Mr. Nawin Kr. Singh, A.P.P.
 ---
05 / 18.08.2023 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner is apprehending her arrest in connection with Giridih Muffasil P.S. Case No. 226/2022 for the offences registered under sections 406, 409, 420, 120B and 34 of the Indian Penal Code,
pending in the court of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Giridih.
3.
Co-accused Nitish Kumar was given work order for supply of LED lamps for installation in Gram Panchayat Akdonikala, Giridih, for a total amount of Rs. 17,66,187/-.
As per the contract, co-accused Nitish Kumar was to install LED lamps.

4. It is alleged that Nitish Kumar in connivance with the present petitioner and other two accused persons, without carrying out the maintenance of installed LED lamps, withdrew Rs. 8,83,094 for the said purpose.
Petitioner is the Mukhiya of Gram Panchayat.
It is stated that she along with co-accused persons had given work completion certificate to Nitish Kumar.
5. It was submitted that co-accused Nitish Kumar had carried out maintenance of LED lamps for a period of two years and Rs. 8,83,094/- was withdrawn after he has performed his part of the contract.
It is further submitted that money was released after due verification and approval by the Block Development Officer.

It was finally submitted that co-accused Nitish Kumar has been granted anticipatory bail by this court vide A.B.A. No. 62/2023.
6.
Considering the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, petitioner, above named, is directed to surrender before the learned court Sunita Devi vs The State Of Jharkhand --- --- Opp. Party on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131715622/
